en.summary: Drop discs into columns and connect four before your friends do.
en.title: Stack Four

zh-Hans.summary: 把棋子落入列中，先连成四子即可获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 四连叠

en.summary: Take one, two, or three stones. Whoever takes the final stone loses.
en.title: Last One Loses

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合拿走一、二或三颗石子，拿走最后一颗的人输。
zh-Hans.title: 最后一个输

en.summary: Take turns sliding numbered tiles into the empty space and restore the grid.
en.title: Pocket Slider

zh-Hans.summary: 轮流将数字滑入空格，在步数用尽前还原方阵。
zh-Hans.title: 掌上华容格

en.summary: Swap neighboring prisms, clear matching lines, and outscore your friends.
en.title: Prism Shift

zh-Hans.summary: 交换相邻棱镜，连成同色消除，在十六回合内赢得最高分。
zh-Hans.title: 棱镜交换

en.summary: Take one, two, or three tokens. The last move wins.
en.title: Take Five

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合拿走一、二或三个标记，拿走最后一个的人获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 拿五

en.summary: Place anywhere on a small board and weave four in a row across the edges.
en.title: Edge Weave

zh-Hans.summary: 在小棋盘任意落子，沿边缘织出四子连线。
zh-Hans.title: 边线织网

en.summary: Build upward in a wide rack; the first five-point skyline wins.
en.title: Skyline Five

zh-Hans.summary: 在宽棋架上向上堆叠，先筑成五点天际线者胜。
zh-Hans.title: 天际五连

en.summary: Claim open squares on a compact board; three aligned marks take the lane.
en.title: Triad Lane

zh-Hans.summary: 占据紧凑棋盘的空格，三点成线即可拿下通道。
zh-Hans.title: 三点通道

en.summary: Drop markers into a long rail and connect four before the route closes.
en.title: Hexa Rail

zh-Hans.summary: 在长棋轨中落子，先连成四子即可封锁路线。
zh-Hans.title: 六轨连线

en.summary: Claim a square board and close a five-point circuit through any direction.
en.title: Corner Circuit

zh-Hans.summary: 在方阵中占位，沿任意方向闭合五点回路。
zh-Hans.title: 角落回路

en.summary: Race across a compact board where three aligned markers open the gate.
en.title: Twin Gates

zh-Hans.summary: 在紧凑棋盘竞逐，三点成线即可打开关门。
zh-Hans.title: 双门竞逐

en.summary: Place across a calm square and climb a diagonal ladder of four.
en.title: Orbit Ladder

zh-Hans.summary: 在方阵中落子，沿对角阶梯连成四子。
zh-Hans.title: 轨道梯线

en.summary: Fill a tall beacon lane and light five markers before the other side.
en.title: Beacon Five

zh-Hans.summary: 在高耸灯塔列中堆叠，先点亮五个标记者胜。
zh-Hans.title: 灯塔五连

en.summary: Claim open cells and send a three-mark current through the center.
en.title: Cross Current

zh-Hans.summary: 占据空格，让三枚标记穿过棋盘中心形成水流。
zh-Hans.title: 交汇水流

en.summary: Grow a four-mark bloom from a gravity rack before the board fills.
en.title: Quadra Bloom

zh-Hans.summary: 在重力棋架中培育四点花瓣，棋盘填满前完成连线。
zh-Hans.title: 四瓣绽放

en.summary: Claim open cells and close a six-mark ring across the square.
en.title: Ring of Six

zh-Hans.summary: 占据开放格，在方阵中闭合六点环线。
zh-Hans.title: 六环成线

en.summary: Thread three marks through a slim vertical board in a quick tactical duel.
en.title: Narrow Three

zh-Hans.summary: 在狭长竖向棋盘中穿出三点连线，快速完成战术对决。
zh-Hans.title: 窄道三连

en.summary: Stretch a patient line across the open board and reach seven in a row.
en.title: Seven Span

zh-Hans.summary: 在开放棋盘中延展布局，先连成七子长线。
zh-Hans.title: 七格延展

en.summary: Turn the corners of an open board and make a four-point pinwheel.
en.title: Pinwheel Four

zh-Hans.summary: 在开放棋盘中转过角落，组成四点风车连线。
zh-Hans.title: 风车四连

en.summary: Raise a quiet tower in one column and complete five stacked marks.
en.title: Vertical Five

zh-Hans.summary: 在一列中安静筑塔，完成五枚叠起的标记。
zh-Hans.title: 垂直五层

en.summary: Spread across an open square and complete an eight-mark octave.
en.title: Octave Grid

zh-Hans.summary: 在开放方阵中铺开布局，完成八枚标记的长线。
zh-Hans.title: 八音方阵

en.summary: Climb a tall gravity board and complete five rungs across the landing rows.
en.title: Ladder Five

zh-Hans.summary: 在高耸重力棋盘中攀升，先完成五个梯级标记。
zh-Hans.title: 梯级五连

en.summary: A broad low field where three aligned marks can change the whole turn.
en.title: Trio Field

zh-Hans.summary: 在宽阔低矮的棋面上落子，三点成线即可改变局势。
zh-Hans.title: 三点平野

en.summary: Hold the open square together and complete a patient nine-mark cross-line.
en.title: Nine Cross

zh-Hans.summary: 在开放方阵中稳住布局，完成九枚标记的长线。
zh-Hans.title: 九方交叉

en.summary: Use a compact gravity rack to build a four-mark stair in the landing rows.
en.title: Stepped Four

zh-Hans.summary: 在紧凑重力棋架中堆叠，筑出四枚标记的阶梯。
zh-Hans.title: 阶梯四连

en.summary: A low, wide field where a quick three-mark line can appear anywhere.
en.title: Wide Three

zh-Hans.summary: 在低矮宽阔的棋面上布局，快速三点成线。
zh-Hans.title: 宽场三连

en.summary: Claim open berths across a broad board and connect six along the harbor.
en.title: Harbor Six

zh-Hans.summary: 在宽阔棋盘上占据泊位，沿港湾连成六枚标记。
zh-Hans.title: 港湾六连

en.summary: Drop into three narrow lanes and race to stack three markers first.
en.title: Column Sprint

zh-Hans.summary: 在三条狭窄竖道中落子，率先叠起三枚标记。
zh-Hans.title: 窄列冲刺

en.summary: Build across a long open field and complete a five-mark bridge.
en.title: Five Bridges

zh-Hans.summary: 在狭长开放棋面上铺设布局，完成五点桥梁连线。
zh-Hans.title: 五桥连阵

en.summary: Cross a large open square and complete a seven-mark diagonal.
en.title: Diagonal Seven

zh-Hans.summary: 穿越大型开放方阵，率先完成七枚标记的对角长线。
zh-Hans.title: 斜贯七连

en.summary: Drop across a twelve-column skyline and connect six along the base.
en.title: Skyline Six

zh-Hans.summary: 沿十二列天际棋架落子，在底部率先连成六枚标记。
zh-Hans.title: 天际六连

en.summary: Build upward in a deep four-lane well and stack six markers vertically.
en.title: Deep Column Six

zh-Hans.summary: 在四道深井棋盘中向上堆叠，率先垂直连成六枚标记。
zh-Hans.title: 深井六层

en.summary: Two to six players relay turns across an open field; four aligned marks win.
en.title: Six-Seat Relay

zh-Hans.summary: 两至六人轮流在开放棋面落子，率先四子成线获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 六席接力

en.summary: Two to six players share a wide gravity rack and race to connect five.
en.title: Crowded Skyline

zh-Hans.summary: 两至六人共享宽幅重力棋架，争先连成五枚标记。
zh-Hans.title: 群星天际

en.summary: Two to six players negotiate a crowded square while building a six-mark diagonal.
en.title: Council Diagonal

zh-Hans.summary: 两至六人在拥挤方阵中轮流布局，争先完成六子对角线。
zh-Hans.title: 议会斜线

en.summary: Two to six players fill a grand gravity board and race to connect seven.
en.title: Grandstand Seven

zh-Hans.summary: 两至六人在大型重力棋盘中落子，争先连成七枚标记。
zh-Hans.title: 看台七连

en.summary: Two to six players cross a broad open board and complete an eight-mark diagonal.
en.title: Long Diagonal Eight

zh-Hans.summary: 两至六人穿越宽阔开放棋盘，争先完成八子对角长线。
zh-Hans.title: 长斜八连

en.summary: Two to six players stack through a deep gravity well; eight vertical markers win.
en.title: Deep Eight

zh-Hans.summary: 两至六人在深井重力棋盘中堆叠，率先垂直连成八枚标记。
zh-Hans.title: 深井八层
